customize.name: Delicious Meat-Filled Rye Bun
customize.desc: Fish-stuffed bread. Crack open its crisp, charred crust, and rich, savory oils come rushing out, followed by the clean sweetness of the fish. In the end, every flavor settles into the hearty crust, now steeped in fragrant juices. A single bite is enough to make even the bitter wind draw back.
